newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's '96 assets rose to $17.4 billion.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's '96 assets rose to $17.4 billion.

text.p: McDonald's Corp, reporting supplemental financial data Thursday, said its total assets in 1996 increased to $17.4 billion from $15.4 billion in 1995.
It said total debt increased nearly $700 million to about $5.5 billion, and the debt-to-capitalization ratio was 39 percent in 1996 and 38 percent the year before.

The restaurant chain also said cash generated from operations totaled $2.5 billion in 1996, exceeding capital expenditures of about $2.4 billion. In 1995, cash generated from operations was $2.3 billion, exceeding capital expenditures of $2.1 billion.
